scripts.dev: uv run python -m server.gen proto && set -a && { [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; } && set +a && uv run uvicorn server.main:app --reload --host ${HOST:-127.0.0.1} --port ${PORT:-8002}
scripts.test: uv run python -m server.gen proto && uv run pytest -q
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: uv run python -m server.gen proto && uv run pyrefly check
scripts.format: uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
